an5.68:1.1: pubbevāhaṃ bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ pañca dhamme bahulimakāsiṃ
an5.68:1.8: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ ussoḷhipañcamānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā yassa yassābhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya
an5.68:1.9: tatratatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane
an5.68:2.1: so sace ākaṅkhiṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ …pa… yāvabrahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti
an5.68:2.2: tatratatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:3.1: so sace ākaṅkhiṃ …pe… āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti
an5.68:3.2: tatratatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyataneti.
